audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read "Skill" (0 through 6) while the matching content win[0..5] all said "Brand" and win[6] said "Senna" — and packet.levelChart independently confirms Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Senna. The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer and the real data on all seven rows.
audit.why: The chart told the reader an even skill matchup at every stage while the page's own prose says Brand wins levels 1 through first-item and Senna out-scales late — the two layers contradicted each other on every row.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..5].side to Brand and phases[6].side to Senna to match win[] and packet.levelChart; rewrote each phases[N].why to state the actual reason since none of the previous why text specified a winner.

audit.why: Level 2 (W-Q punishes her fragile early kit), level 6 (Dawning Shadow is global utility, not a duel-winner), and late (stacked souls out-range and out-sustain the poke) are the real spikes and are already named correctly in the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The needs-antiheal missingInteraction (Piercing Darkness (Q) self/ally sustain) never reached the page. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and breakdown.cooldowns had no real numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). report[8].t misgendered Senna as his.
audit.why: Senna's Q heals whoever it hits, so extended trades without Grievous Wounds timed correctly let her sustain through Brand's chip.
audit.corrected: Folded the anti-heal fact into dosFull[1].d, replaced dontsFull[2].d with the Dawning Shadow shield fact, added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed the pronoun.

edits.before: W-poke the pair — the pillar splashes bot's formation tax from level 1.
edits.after: Senna is fragile early with one slow, telegraphed trade tool — Pillar of Flame punishes every walk-up.

edits.before: E joins: the ablaze-stun package threatens; the lane flinches at level 2.
edits.after: W-Q lands first and stacks Blaze — her telegraphed Q can't answer the stun-and-auto tax at 2.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stuns through the wave and the W bills the dodge attempt.
edits.after: Poke keeps compounding while Senna is stuck farming souls under pressure at level 3.

edits.before: Rotation-chip the margins — three spells on anyone is a detonation event.
edits.after: You out-range her un-stacked auto and Sear stuns her out of Q casts at 4-5.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — grouped duos pay the bounce tax; never lane in a line.
edits.after: Dawning Shadow is a global utility tool, not a duel-winner — her in-lane weakness still decides level 6.

edits.before: First item: the burn compounds and the stun package deletes.
edits.after: First item locks in the poke lead — you out-range and deny souls before her scaling lands.

edits.before: Late support Brand is a teamfight bill: spread the blaze, R the clump, and stun the survivors.
edits.after: Stacked range, lifesteal, and Dawning Shadow's global shield let her out-scale your poke at 2+ items.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Piercing Darkness (Q) heals her back on hit — force Grievous Wounds up before you start an extended trade.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
